reviews.description: DIRT, MetaMAT and Nallok walk through an early Futarchy-as-a-Service demonstration for FutureDAO. They explain conditional token minting, trading, reclaiming paired balances, TWAPs and proposal liquidity, then discuss interface issues and planned next steps. The recording explicitly describes a devnet demo; it does not establish a completed mainnet launch.
